mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kafka_dlt_replay_job (id, actor_account_id, actor_session_id, source_dlt_topic, source_partition, source_offset, source_timestamp, source_key_sha256, payload_size, destination_topic, replay_attempt, replay_root, reason, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorAccountId}, #{actorSessionId}, #{sourceDltTopic}, #{sourcePartition}, #{sourceOffset}, #{sourceTimestamp}, #{sourceKeySha256}, #{payloadSize}, #{destinationTopic}, #{replayAttempt}, #{replayRoot}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) VALUES (#{auditId}, NULL, #{actorAccountId}, #{actorSessionId}, 'KAFKA_DLT_REPLAY_REQUESTED', 'kafka_dlt_replay_job', #{jobId}, 'PENDING', #{reason}, #{occurredAt}, jsonb_build_object('sourceDltTopic', #{sourceDltTopic}, 'sourcePartition', #{sourcePartition}, 'sourceOffset', #{sourceOffset}, 'destinationTopic', #{destinationTopic}, 'replayAttempt', #{replayAttempt}, 'replayRoot', #{replayRoot}))
mapper.update: UPDATE kafka_dlt_replay_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', destination_partition = #{destinationPartition}, destination_offset = #{destinationOffset}, destination_timestamp = #{destinationTimestamp}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_audit_event (id, tenant_id, actor_account_id, session_id, event_type, resource_type, resource_id, outcome, reason, occurred_at, details) SELECT #{auditId}, NULL, actor_account_id, actor_session_id, #{eventType}, 'kafka_dlt_replay_job', id, #{outcome}, reason, #{occurredAt}, jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('failureReason', #{failureReason}, 'destinationPartition', #{destinationPartition}, 'destinationOffset', #{destinationOffset})) FROM kafka_dlt_replay_job WHERE id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_account_id, actor_session_id, source_dlt_topic, source_partition, source_offset, source_timestamp, source_key_sha256, payload_size, destination_topic, replay_attempt, replay_root, reason, status, destination_partition, destination_offset, destination_timestamp, failure_reason, created_at, completed_at FROM kafka_dlt_replay_job WHERE id = #{jobId}
